title: UAP Disclosure Act eminent domain over privately held material

tellings.quote: this is why the UP disclosure act explicitly targeted eminent domain right for things held in private hands

(a) Exercise of Eminent Domain.--The Federal Government shall exercise eminent domain over any and all recovered technologies of unknown origin and biological evidence of non-human intelligence that may be controlled by private persons or entities in the interests of the public good.

plain: The researcher Matthew Pines tells Michels that the 2023 UAP Disclosure Act deliberately reached for eminent domain, the government's power to take private property for public use, so it could seize unusual material held by private companies. This would mean lawmakers believed such material sits in private hands. The bill Senator Chuck Schumer submitted on 13 July 2023 does say: "The Federal Government shall exercise eminent domain over any and all recovered technologies of unknown origin and biological evidence of non-human intelligence that may be controlled by private persons or entities in the interests of the public good."
